notesStmt.note: This manuscript was most likely written in late 1883 or early 1884, shortly before the poem appeared in Harper's. The cancelled prose on the verso concerns John Burroughs's Notes on Walt Whitman, As Poet and Person, published in 1867 and again, in an expanded form, in 1871. It is therefore possible, though unlikely, that Whitman had begun drafting the material for "With Husky-Haughty Lips, O Sea!" many years before it was published.

"With Husky-Haughty Lips, O Sea!" was published first in the March 1884 issue of Harper's Monthly Magazine. It was reprinted, with the addition of one line, in November Boughs (1888) and in the "Sands at Seventy" annex to Leaves of Grass in 1888 and after.
